_quarto:
  tests:

      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["nav#TOC ul[data-toc-expanded=\"-1\"]"]
        - ["nav#TOC [data-toc-expanded=\"0\"]"]

bd-kr6721bn. Quarto 1 treats `toc-expand: 0` as falsy and writes `-1`,
the same as `toc-expand: false`, so nested lists start collapsed.
